large_unit: derive conservative close-reserve update rule without overfitting one 32s sample
rule_candidate: Until >=5 comparable clean close samples exist, do not reduce the 60s provisional reserve. Once >=5 exist, estimate a high observed quantile plus explicit safety margin; if any clean-close loss occurs at/below candidate, increase reserve and roll back cap.
reason: One sample is insufficient to estimate variance; reducing reserve now would optimize on noise.
